US Sanctions Indian Firm and CEO Over Sudan Civil War Role

The U.S. Treasury Department has sanctioned an Indian firm and its CEO, along with seven other entities, for allegedly supplying weapons and explosives that fueled Sudan's civil war. These networks are accused of enabling both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces to intensify the conflict, exacerbating a humanitarian crisis. The sanctions highlight the international implications of the ongoing Sudanese conflict.
